definitions.explanation: A son of a king or queen, or a male royal.

examples.japanese: {王子|おうじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{お姫様|ひめさま}→姫：12233_hime⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{助|たす}けた→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧。
⟦{白馬|はくば}→白馬：19404_hakuba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{王子|おうじ}。
examples.english: A prince on a white horse.
The prince will become the next king.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧{王子|おうじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{冒険|ぼうけん}→冒険：03629_bouken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: The little prince set out on an adventure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{白馬|はくば}→白馬：19404_hakuba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{王子|おうじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ずっと→ずっと：00912_zutto⟧⟦{待|ま}っていた→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: She had been waiting all along for her prince charming to come.

notes:
{王子|おうじ} means prince—a son of a king or queen, or a male royal.

FORMS:
⟦{王|おう}→王：19353_ou⟧ (king) + ⟦{子|じ}→子：09851_ko⟧ (child) = king's child

RELATED ROYAL TERMS:
- ⟦{王女|おうじょ}→王女：04108_oujo⟧: princess (king's daughter)
- ⟦{王様|おうさま}→王様：01902_ousama⟧: king
- ⟦{女王|じょおう}→女王：03349_joou⟧: queen
- ⟦お{姫様|ひめさま}→お姫様：19130_ohimesama⟧: princess (informal)

JAPANESE IMPERIAL FAMILY:
- ⟦{皇太子|こうたいし}→皇太子：15717_koutaishi⟧: crown prince
- ⟦{皇太子妃|こうたいしひ}→皇太子妃：noentry⟧: crown princess

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
⟦{白馬|はくば}→白馬：19404_hakuba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{王子|おうじ} (prince on a white horse): prince charming, ideal romantic partner

USAGE:
Common in fairy tales and stories. Also used figuratively for an ideal romantic partner.
